content.text:
{
  "window_id": "w0029",
  "observed_failures": [
    "074.jpg amount wrong: predicted 702.00 vs likely correct 332.30 (OCR misread of 332.30 as 702.00 or picked wrong line)",
    "077.jpg amount wrong: predicted 23.26 but receipt shows TOTAL 23.25 (final rounded) — picked 'Total (Inclusive of GST): 23.26' before 'TOTAL: 23.25' rounding adj",
    "078.jpg amount null: Thai Delicious receipt with 'Total: 92.80' and 'Grand Total: 92.80' not recovered due to OCR noise ('Grand Tota.', 'a Total — 92:80'); keyword regex too strict",
    "034.jpg date wrong: predicted 2018-08-09 vs likely 2018-03-09 (DD/MM/YYYY '09/03/2018' misparsed as MM/DD or day/month swap)",
    "Agent run terminated via max_iterations after 65 turns, indicating excessive iteration on OCR tuning without converging"
  ],
  "root_causes": [
    "Total-amount selection does not account for receipts where a pre-rounding 'Total (Inclusive of GST)' line precedes a final rounded 'TOTAL:' line; current priority picks the first/earlier TOTAL match instead of preferring the LAST qualifying total (after rounding adjustment)",
    "Keyword matching for GRAND TOTAL / TOTAL is brittle to OCR noise: punctuation attached ('Tota.', 'Total:'), colon/period substitutions in numbers ('92:80' instead of '92.80'), and missing spaces break word-boundary regex",
    "Date parser ambiguity: DD/MM/YYYY vs MM/DD/YYYY not disambiguated; when both day and month are <=12, the parser silently chooses the wrong order (e.g. 09/03/2018 → month=9 instead of month=3). Skill lacks locale/context guidance (receipts in dataset are Malaysian → DD/MM/YYYY dominant)",
    "Number regex does not tolerate OCR colon-for-decimal substitution ('92:80') or spaced decimals, so valid totals are discarded",
    "Multi-pass OCR variants are tried ad-hoc inside the agent rather than codified in the skill; fallback preprocessing (3x upscale + PSM 4) that recovers hard cases is discovered empirically but not persisted as guidance",
    "Agent spent iterations re-tuning OCR per-image rather than committing to a batch pipeline, exhausting iteration budget"
  ],
  "skill_defects": [
    "image-ocr: total extraction rule 'FIRST matching line scanning top-to-bottom' is wrong for receipts with both a pre-rounding and a post-rounding total; should prefer the LAST matching line within the highest-priority tier (or the line following a 'Rounding Adj' line)",
    "image-ocr: keyword list for exclusions is missing 'ROUNDING', 'ROUNDING ADJ', 'ROUNDING ADJUSTMENT', 'SERVICE CHARGE', 'SERV CHARGE', 'ITEM COUNT', 'POINTS', 'CASH', 'VISA', 'MASTERCARD', 'CARD', 'PAYMENT', 'BALANCE' (non-due), 'TENDERED' — several caused confusion in the run",
    "image-ocr: NUM_RE does not accept OCR variants where '.' is misread as ':' or ','; no normalization step for digit/punctuation confusions before parsing",
    "image-ocr: keyword matching uses strict substring on uppercased line but does not strip trailing punctuation or collapse whitespace, so 'GRAND TOTA.' or 'TOTAL :' edge cases are lost",
    "image-ocr: DATE_PATTERNS prefers numeric formats in order but does not disambiguate DD/MM vs MM/DD when both components ≤12; no default-locale guidance for Malaysian receipts (DD/MM/YYYY)",
    "image-ocr: no guidance that for failed single-pass extraction, agent should run multi-pass with upscale (2x–3x) + PSM 4/6 and aggregate candidate totals across passes, choosing the mode/most-frequent plausible value",
    "image-ocr: 'Critical Rules' says sort by filename but doesn't warn that iteration budget is limited; no guidance to commit a batch pipeline and avoid per-image interactive tuning",
    "xlsx: no reminder that string columns like total_amount must be preserved as object dtype AND that NaN/None must be written as empty cell (not literal 'None' or 'nan') — this run happened to produce empty string for 078 rather than null, which the field feedback marked as amount incorrect"
  ],
  "repair_recommendations": [
    "image-ocr: change total-selection rule to 'within the highest-priority keyword tier, take the LAST qualifying line (bottom-up), unless an explicit ROUNDING ADJ/ROUNDED line follows a tentative total, in which case take the line after rounding adjustment'. Document the rationale with a Malaysian receipt example (Total 20.98 → Rounding Adj 0.02 → Total RM 21.00).",
    "image-ocr: expand EXCLUSIONS to include 'ROUNDING', 'ROUNDING ADJ', 'ROUNDING ADJUSTMENT', 'ROUNDED', 'SERVICE CHARGE', 'SERV CHARGE', 'ITEM COUNT', 'POINTS AWARDED', 'VISA', 'MASTERCARD', 'CARD', 'PAYMENT', 'TENDERED', 'CHANGE DUE', 'BALANCE' (keep 'BALANCE DUE' as inclusion). Clarify exclusion is substring-based on an uppercased, punctuation-stripped line.",
    "image-ocr: add a preprocessing normalization step before NUM_RE: replace ':' between two digit groups with '.', collapse spaces inside numeric candidates, strip 'RM'/'$' prefixes, so '92:80' → '92.80' and 'RM 21.00' → '21.00'. Update NUM_RE example accordingly and add unit-test-style examples in the skill.",
    "image-ocr: make keyword matching robust: uppercase the line, strip trailing punctuation [.,:;], collapse internal whitespace, then substring-match against tier keywords. Allow 'GRANDTOTAL' (no-space) and 'NETTOTAL' as synonyms.",
    "image-ocr: add a Date Disambiguation section stating that when both day and month are ≤12 and format is numeric slash/dash, default to DD/MM/YYYY (Malaysian/EU convention) unless the four-digit year appears first. Provide code showing explicit preference order and an override hook.",
    "image-ocr: add a 'Robust Multi-Pass Receipt Pipeline' section with concrete code: for each image, run the single-pass pipeline first; if date or total is None, retry with (a) 2x upscale + PSM 6, (b) 3x upscale + PSM 4, (c) autocontrast + sharpen + PSM 6. Collect all candidate totals across passes and vote; prefer values that appear in ≥2 passes.",
    "image-ocr: add explicit guidance 'Do NOT interactively tune per image. Build the batch pipeline once, run it over all files, and accept per-image None rather than exceeding iteration budget.' Add a note that total_amount=None must be written as empty cell (openpyxl None) not string.",
    "xlsx: add a short subsection 'Writing nullable string columns' showing that for columns like total_amount formatted as '47.70', the DataFrame column must be dtype=object, and None values must be preserved via df.astype(object).where(pd.notna(df), None) before to_excel, so verifier sees empty cells (not 'nan' / 'None').",
    "image-ocr: add Quality Self-Check items: (i) when both pre-rounding and post-rounding totals exist, the post-rounding value is used; (ii) ':' between digits normalized to '.'; (iii) DD/MM assumed when ambiguous; (iv) exclusions include ROUNDING and payment-method lines."
  ],
  "confidence": "medium"
}
